status.summary: Former UFC light heavyweight champion (won the vacant title from Glover Teixeira at UFC 283, Jan 21, 2023; vacated it in July 2023 after rupturing his Achilles tendon). Since returning he has lost three straight: KO by Alex Pereira (UFC 300, Apr 13, 2024), TKO by Jiri Prochazka (UFC 311, Jan 18, 2025) and a unanimous decision to Khalil Rountree Jr. (UFC Baku, Jun 21, 2025). In October 2025 he had knee surgery, a cartilage transplant, and said he was looking at a return around the end of 2026. In 2026 he announced a move to heavyweight and has asked for Josh Hokit in his debut (Sherdog, Aug 12, 2026), but no fight is booked as of Nov 6, 2026 (not on any UFC card in the ESPN schedule through Feb 2027; MMA Sucka on Oct 22: no date for a heavyweight debut). Medical clearance for the knee has not been reported. Pro record 12-4 (1 NC).
status.ranking: Unranked: not in the UFC light heavyweight top 15 of either the Meta rankings (Oct 31, 2026) or the media-panel rankings (Nov 3, 2026), per ufcalendar.com; Sherdog also dropped him from its light heavyweight top 15 for inactivity on Nov 2, 2026. Not ranked at heavyweight

style.summary: A tall, long southpaw who fights at range behind the jab and straight left, mixes in body punches and throws a lot: he landed 232 significant strikes over five rounds to win the title from Teixeira. Since his 2023 Achilles rupture he has lost three straight, two by knockout, and recaps of the Rountree fight say kicks compromised his legs.

moves.notes: Southpaw: 'cross' is his straight left, 'jab' his right, 'hook' a lead right hook. Each group sums to 1; the engine's target split picks the group. Decayed sums in fighters.json: significant attempts 81% head, 13% body, 6% legs; landed 69% head, 21% body, 11% legs; career landed body share 23%. The head group is dominated by the jab and straight left, which is how sources describe a rangy striker using his height and reach; hooks and uppercuts get less. Body work is mostly punches by the 42/49 body landed vs Teixeira and his low kick rate, so straights and hooks to the body outweigh body kicks (no source details the mix). Leg kicks are rare and unspecified, so calf and inside split evenly. Elbow 0.15 for the ground elbows that finished Santos; knee small (6% of attempts in the clinch); no spinning techniques recorded. Sources: data/derived/fighters.json; ufcstats per-fight totals.

In 5-round fights his landed rate relative to round 1 runs 1.00, 1.57, 0.96, 2.47, 0.92 (minute-weighted, mostly the Teixeira and Rountree fights).

No UFC fight since Jun 21, 2025, a cartilage-transplant knee surgery in Oct 2025, and he plans to debut at heavyweight. All his stats are from 205 lb; heavyweight inputs should lean on the division prior with layoff and injury discounts.
Takedown defense 71% career; Santos (6/20) and Teixeira (2/17) were the only sustained wrestling tests, and Teixeira matched his 206 s of control.
